requirements.description: User prefers properties near healthcare services. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 360. The capacity of 18 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. The Turin location and the proximity to healthcare services are handled by the Location Agent, and no energy class requirement was specified.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 360 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND healthcare >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters offices-type properties (property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 360 sqm, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates (haversine on latitude/longitude), and healthcare proximity score >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the center point, nearest first. No energy or capacity filters were applied since they were not in the extracted requirements.
